node.statement: For the base V and scale r=c*delta occurring here (with fixed c and the root guard chosen small), the epsilon-C*-axioms give ||L_{V^dagger}L_V-I|| <= C*(epsilon_r+r): indeed L_{V^dagger}L_V Z-Z is the sum of the associator V^dagger bold-dot (V bold-dot Z)-(V^dagger bold-dot V) bold-dot Z and (V^dagger bold-dot V-J) bold-dot Z, bounded respectively by epsilon_r*||V||^2*||Z|| and (1+epsilon_r)*2r*||Z||; while (1-epsilon_r)||V||^2 <= ||V^dagger bold-dot V|| <= 1+2r bounds ||V|| universally. Thus the guard makes the displayed operator norm at most 1/4. Hence L_V is injective, and because it is an endomorphism of the finite-dimensional space it is bijective; moreover if T=L_{V^dagger}L_V and ||T-I||<=1/4, then ||T^{-1}||<=4/3 and L_V^{-1}=T^{-1}L_{V^dagger}, so ||L_V^{-1}|| is universally bounded.
